drivingQuestion: May a minor be counted toward a zimmun?
outcomeNote: Two tannaitic positions are set side by side with no argument between them in this unit; nothing is adjudicated here.

segments.he: נָשִׁים וַעֲבָדִים וּקְטַנִּים אֵין מְזַמְּנִין עֲלֵיהֶן. אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: קָטָן הַמּוּטָּל בַּעֲרִיסָה מְזַמְּנִין עָלָיו.
segments.en: We also learned in the mishna that «women, slaves, and minors are not included in a zimmun. Rabbi Yosei said: A minor lying in a cradle is included in a zimmun.»

moves.cueHe: נשים ועבדים וקטנים אין מזמנין עליהן
moves.summary: women, slaves and minors are barred from the zimmun
moves.about: the mishna's clause that women, slaves and minors are not counted for a zimmun

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יוסי: קטן המוטל בעריסה מזמנין עליו
moves.summary: Rabbi Yosei counts even a minor in a cradle
moves.about: whether a minor — even one still lying in a cradle — may be counted toward a zimmun
